# pdf-lib 1.17.1

The ES module build of [pdf-lib](https://github.com/Hopding/pdf-lib), copied
from `node_modules/pdf-lib/dist/pdf-lib.esm.min.js` of the version pinned in
`package.json`, with its source-map comment removed. MIT licensed; see
`LICENSE.md`.

Used only by the Email the reports panel, to lift each student's page out of
the saved reports PDF as a PDF of its own. Nothing loads it until a PDF is
chosen there.
